title: The Municipal Chamber of Serra
description: camaraserra.es.gov.br The Municipal Chamber of Serra (Câmara Municipal da Serra) is the legislative body of the city of Serra, located in the state of Espírito Santo, Brazil. As the largest legislative house in the state, it is composed of elected councilors responsible for creating local laws, overseeing the executive branch, and representing the citizens' interests. The institution is committed to transparency, active public participation, and the sustainable development of the municipality through its plenary sessions and specialized committees.
